verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Vulkan backend. The only AMD GPU evidence concerns ROCm: shipped ROCm containers, and a log showing Ollama falling back to CPU when no compatible ROCm library is found. That suggests AMD acceleration depends on ROCm, which is the opposite of this story, and is an adjacent capability rather than the one requested.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
